run_REINFORCE_experiment: run a REINFORCE reinforcement learning experiment on CartPole-v0 with evaluation environments
create_env: create multiple Gym environments wrapped with TimeLimit and GymEnv for parallel training
create_gym_env: create a single Gym environment by name using gym.make for the specified environment

review_Experiment_class: review the Experiment class that extends Reinforce for REINFORCE training with evaluation
